name: PT Astra Graphia Tbk
summary: PT Astra Graphia Tbk engages in the trading, industrial, consulting, office equipment and supplies contracting, information technology, telecommunication, professional, scientific and technical, and investment businesses in Indonesia. It operates through Document Solution and Information Technology Solution segments.
